title: Zucchini Bread Breakfast Pizza
description: Zucchini bread is the "crust" in this zucchini bread breakfast pizza layered with Greek yogurt, fruit, and maple syrup.
ingredients: 0.25 teaspoon orange zest, or to taste
1 teaspoon maple syrup, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Combine coconut flour and cinnamon in a bowl. Add zucchini, egg, 1 1/2 teaspoon maple syrup, and vanilla extract and mix well. Spread zucchini mixture into the form of a pizza crust on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until zucchini "crust" is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Cool "crust".
Spread yogurt onto zucchini "crust" and top with strawberries, grapes, banana, orange zest, and a drizzle of maple syrup.

video.description: In this video, we'll show you a quick way to mash up two breakfast favorites: zucchini bread and fruit pizza! First we'll make a grain and gluten-free zucchini crust using coconut flour, shredded fresh zucchini, egg, maple syrup for a little sweetness and a splash of vanilla. Form, bake and cool the crust before topping with Greek yogurt and sliced fresh fruits.
